'''Kalf Arranda''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and the father of [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash]] and [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]].

==Biography==
Kalf Arranda was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]. He married [[Milessa Arranda]] and had two children, [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]] and [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]]. During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] he sent his two children to vacation with [[Mammon Hoole]]. While the children were off-[[Planet/Legends|planet]], Kalf and his wife were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]].
